task.title: Backfill expanded Supabase mirror after schema install
task.body:
After expanded Supabase schema task t_fa6eb9c1 is completed, run the internal Growth OS mirror backfill once for all nightly runs now represented only by partial reports (2026-05-06 through 2026-05-09).

Deliverables expected:
- A dated backfill report under /Users/jeff/Documents/Codex/2026-05-05/i-want-to-install-hermes-agent/whiteford-ai-law-pages/docs/nightly-lead-research/ or /Users/jeff/.openclaw/projects/mountain-west-growth-os/reports/ confirming the phase 6-11 expanded tables are present and that `node scripts/sync-sqlite-to-supabase.mjs` completed against them.
- Update /Users/jeff/Documents/Codex/2026-05-05/i-want-to-install-hermes-agent/whiteford-ai-law-pages/docs/KANBAN_DELIVERABLE_INDEX.md with the report.
- Leave a Kanban deliverable comment in the standard format.

Guardrails:
- Internal Supabase mirror/backfill only after schema exists; do not attempt DDL without DDL-capable credentials.
- No email sends, workflow activation, contact enrollment, LinkedIn/social action, Clio writes, public page publish, ad launch, or client-facing changes.
- If expanded tables are still missing or credentials are insufficient, block with exact manual unblock steps instead of retrying unsafe actions.

Context: partial reports already exist for t_61df202d (2026-05-06), t_539e8920 (2026-05-07), t_0c197c43 (2026-05-08), and t_03f9aebc (2026-05-09). This single gated backfill replaces keeping all four partial mirror tasks blocked indefinitely.
